Background: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE man only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of his head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside him at normal human scale so his extreme height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
